findings.text: `_attempt_ended_after` re-reads `attempt-N-exit.json` with its own json.loads, Mapping check and attempt comparison, duplicating the exit-receipt reader the repository already owns at `reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1415` (`_run_exit_record(record, name, require_run_id=True)`); it duplicates rather than extends or wraps that owner, so a change to the receipt shape or its run-id strictness must now be made in two places.

`assert command in duty["next_command"]` compares against `command`, the value the test itself passes in as `row["next_action"]`, which `_review_duty_item` forwards to `_reflex_open_refusal(dispatch=...)` and the fallback returns verbatim; the assertion is therefore satisfied by echoing the test's own input rather than by an independent source. It still reddens against the prior `next_command = reason` branch, and line 318 (`assert refusal in duty["reason"]`) is independent, so durability does not rest on this line alone.

The third case the done_when describes as "the reflex's dispatch fail[ing] with an injected refusal" builds a pointer carrying `resume_launch_in_flight` and calls `obligations._review_duty_item` directly; it never runs a sweep or an injected-refusal dispatch, so it asserts the duty's reading of the shared predicate but not the dispatch's `_record_review_dispatch(status="refused")` write, which would regress unobserved.

Line 12 glues `retry_failures:` onto the end of the `changed_paths` value with no newline, so `changed_paths` carries a trailing `...review.pyretry_failures:` token and the `retry_failures` key is absent; lines 18-19 record the two suite arms as bare JSON objects with no `baseline_suite:`/`after_suite:` key, and line 14 records `tests:` as prose rather than the literal command. The evidence is not lost (gate-base.log and gate-head.log carry revision, literal command and EXIT=), but the manifest's own fields are unreadable to a promotion that reads them by key.

justifications.durability: tests/test_every_delivery_the_reflex_owns_gets_its_review.py:266 and :318 redden on the base revision, as gate-base-negative-control.log records (2 failed, 1 passed), so both repaired behaviours have a test that fails if they regress.
justifications.evidence: The gate in gate-head.log resolves the done-when's 12 importing files at the head revision with -n 4 and records 2 failed/63 passed against gate-base.log's 2 failed/60 passed with identical ids, so 0 failures were added.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2942 follows the surrounding lazy-import and fail-closed idiom and reuses `runs._manifest_freshness` as the manifest owner; ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on all three changed files.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:171 accepts a delivery settled by the attempt's exit record, which is the exact state the field report says never reached a review.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2910 duplicates the owned exit-receipt reader at reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1415 instead of calling it, which is why the dimension is capped.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff is one of the manifest's declared write paths; the reflex pass in reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py is untouched and named in outside_scope.

verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 287b29e; one commit, four files, +467/-27, moving the delivery guards into one shared predicate, adding the supervisor-exit-record delivery evidence, and rewriting the duty's no-finding refusal fallback.
verdicts.done_when: The done_when's cases are tests/test_every_delivery_the_reflex_owns_gets_its_review.py; gate-head.log shows the node's three cases green inside the 12-file arm with 2 failed/63 passed, identical failure ids to gate-base.log's 2 failed/60 passed (0 added), and gate-base-negative-control.log shows 2 failed/1 passed on the base revision.
verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that every delivery the reflex owns gets its review; `_settled_delivery_refusal` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2942) and the exit-record leg in `_resumed_attempt_delivered` (:171) make the repair delivery dispatchable, and the duty fallback in `_reflex_open_refusal` (reckon/crew/obligations.py:1082) names the refusal and the hand-dispatch command.
verdicts.manifest: Read; it records commits 753ef7fbac, both gate log paths, a negative-control log and an honest zero-added claim, but its changed_paths/retry_failures line is malformed and the two suite-arm keys are absent.
verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, reckon/crew/reflex.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/ and the landing fragment; the diff touches recovery_review_dispatch.py, obligations.py, tests/test_every_delivery_the_reflex_owns_gets_its_review.py and that fragment, all inside the grant, with reflex.py correctly left untouched.
